categories.name: Admission NC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward. This contributes to general inpatient care after stabilization or initial sepsis workup in the emergency department.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative Admission NC (id=15), as evidenced by frequent occurrences in standard inpatient paths such as variant V0008, and measured by discharge outcomes.

categories.name: Admission IC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward. This alternative has a negative contribution link to minimizing time-to-treatment due to higher transfer overhead, but is utilized for severe cases.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative Admission IC (id=16), as observed in severe and complex variants like V0605 and V0317.
